level_formula_check: Breloom/Ursaring/Luxray offset 1 -> L83, Kommo-o offset 2 -> L84. Confirmed.

attempts.narrative: T1 Ursaring Protected its Flame Orb turn (authored), Fake Out flinched Breloom, Moonblast into the Protect. T2 Moonblast OHKOed the burned Ursaring before its chosen Facade; Breloom double-crit Bullet Seed 126 into Rillaboom. T3 Luxray switched to Kommo-o and came back as Breloom's replacement (Intimidate twice, -2 on both my actives); Grassy Glide broke the Sash and Moonblast KOed Breloom. T4 Kommo-o Protect (nothing aimed at it), Luxray Wild Charge into Flutter Mane's Protect, U-turn to Landorus. T5 Luxray Protect blocked Earth Power, Moonblast 4x OHKO Kommo-o. T6 Earth Power KO Luxray.

strategy_checks.evidence: Flutter Mane was a legal sleep target all three turns; Breloom chose Bullet Seed on T1 (flinched), T2 and T3. Rock Tomb and Mach Punch never used either.

strategy_checks.evidence: T4 Protect (empty), T5 OHKOed by 4x Moonblast (Bulletproof irrelevant).

could_this_be_cooler: The Luxray double-Intimidate switch cycle was a real idea executed by the AI on its own; that plus the Flame Orb Protect turn are the good parts. The Spore scoring is the thing to look at: a Fairy/Ghost lead is exactly the target Spore should be aimed at and it never was. Not changed in this pass.
